segments.title: Repo Co-Op Gaming Session
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell abandons the news desk for a full-stream co-op session of the horror extraction game R.E.P.O. with producers and friends; Pepito delivers the cold open before ceding control to the gaming cohort.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast from the newsroom desk but pivots immediately to a multi-hour R.E.P.O. co-op stream with guests.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the standard top-of-hour cold open and station identification before the gaming session begins.

lore_notes.fact: Announces a Monday 'News Ice Stravaganza' where he will repeatedly dunk his head in ice water based on bit thresholds (debating 300 vs 500 bits).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's standard sign-on before anchor Case Blackwell diverts the entire broadcast into a cooperative R.E.P.O. gaming session with producers Ian and Golden Boy, correspondents Gina and Ovely, and a rotating cast of friends. The stream concludes with a raid redirect to Christine (Kendelle's sister) after the original target logs off, and Blackwell teases a Monday ice-dunking spectacle funded by viewer bits.
